notes: rho_q: signed Kristoufek form (q>0), mean over scales; "abs" = mean over scales of |rho(q,s)| (the rho_dcca_markets convention). width: h_xy(-3) - h_xy(3) from fathon-convention F_xy (abs point by point) and from window-abs F_xy (Zhou MF-DXA). AUC rank-based, within-market pairs, all coalition pairs vs pairs outside any coalition; AUC < 0.5 means the score is lower for colluders. chunk() has no offset parameter, so the copy world is run once.
